verses.text: A reflection by David from when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry out loud to the LORD. I ask the LORD out loud for mercy.
I pour out my complaint in front of him and tell him all my trouble.
When my spirit was overwhelmed inside me, you knew the path I was on. On the path I walk, they’ve hidden a trap for me.
Look to my right and see. There’s nobody looking out for me. I’ve got nowhere to run, and no one cares whether I live.
I cried out to you, LORD. I said, “You’re my shelter, my share in the land of the living.”
Listen to my cry because I’m desperate. Save me from those coming after me, because they’re too strong for me.
Get my soul out of prison so I can thank your name. Righteous people will gather around me, because you’ll be good to me.
